theme.name: Modern languages as a rigorous interdisciplinary subject
theme.claim: The study of a modern language is an interdisciplinary subject offering the same cognitive and academic advantages as other humanities disciplines.

text.line: The study of a modern language is understood to be an interdisciplinary subject offering the same cognitive and academic advantages as other disciplines within the humanities.

theme.name: Broad transferable benefits
theme.claim: Beyond practical language skills, AS/A level modern languages content builds intercultural competence and transferable skills (communication, critical thinking, autonomy, creativity, cognitive flexibility) valuable to individuals, society, higher education and employers.

text.line: In addition to high level practical language skills, the content of AS and A level in modern languages provides depth of knowledge, understanding and intercultural competence and fosters a range of transferable skills such as communication skills, critical thinking, autonomy, resourcefulness, creativity, and linguistic, cultural and cognitive flexibility; all of which are of value to the individual, to wider society, to higher education and to employers.

theme.name: Relevance to all students
theme.claim: The content is designed to be of value to students of all disciplines, not only those intending further study in the subject.

text.line: The content for AS and A level in a modern language has been designed to be of relevance to students of all disciplines, whether they intend to progress to further study in the subject or not.

theme.name: Foundation for degree-level study
theme.claim: The specification provides a robust foundation for students wishing to progress to degree-level or equivalent study of a modern language.

text.line: It will provide a robust foundation for those wishing to study a modern language to degree level or equivalent.
